sloka: त्वम् हि त्रिपथगा देवि ब्रह्म लोकम् समीक्षसे ।भार्या च उदधि राजस्य लोके अस्मिन् सम्प्रदृश्यसे ॥२-५२-८६॥
transliteration: tvam hi tripathagā devi brahma lokam samīkṣase ।bhāryā ca udadhi rājasya loke asmin sampradṛśyase ॥2-52-86॥

translations.english: O Devi, you are Tripathaga, flowing in three directions (worlds). You behold the region of Brahma and happen to be the spouse of the king of the ocean in this world (of mortals).
